PathPlan – Your Personal AI Travel Assistant
Discover smarter, stress-free travel with PathPlan, your all-in-one trip planning companion. Whether you're traveling solo or with friends, PathPlan helps you organize, explore, and enjoy every moment of your journey — effortlessly.

Why PathPlan?
AI-Powered Itinerary Creation
Let PathPlan design your perfect trip! Get personalized day-by-day schedules tailored to your preferences, destinations, and travel style — including top attractions, hidden gems, meals, and activities.

Smart Destination Planning
Just enter your city, travel dates, and interests — and we’ll craft a full itinerary that fits your vibe.

Food & Fun, Just Right
Craving great food? PathPlan recommends the best breakfast, lunch, and dinner spots based on your location and taste.

Real-Time Navigation Support
Get directions and transportation options like walking, buses, subways, or even Uber — right when you need them.

Pinpoint Accuracy
Each stop includes precise latitude and longitude coordinates, so you’ll never get lost again.

Seamless Scheduling
Your daily itinerary includes time for meals, breaks, and exploration — all paced for comfort and enjoyment.

Live Updates & Flexibility
Change of plans? PathPlan updates your schedule instantly to keep your trip running smoothly.

Explore More Nearby
We’ll show you top-rated attractions near your planned route to help you make the most of your trip.

Optimized Time Management
No more rushing — PathPlan adjusts activity timing so you have time to truly experience every place.

Offline Mode
No Wi-Fi? No problem. Access your full itinerary even without internet.

Make every trip unforgettable with PathPlan
Whether you're exploring a new city or revisiting a favorite place, PathPlan gives you the tools to travel with confidence, ease, and excitement.
